title: Calculating Percentages
summary: A percentage is a part per hundred. To find X% of a number, multiply by X and divide by 100; to find what percent A is of B, divide A by B and multiply by 100.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
